body.objective: Characterize Weyl gravity FULLY in the reverse-physics sense: for each layer of the theory, which minimal physical assumptions is the layer EQUIVALENT to, with independence witnesses and an honest ledger. Four layers. (1) THE ACTION is done: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 shows S = alpha int sqrt(-g) C^2 is equivalent to five assumptions rather than implied by six, with the derivative order DERIVED from D - 2k = 0 rather than assumed, and RP-PARITY independent on actions but redundant on field equations. (2) THE FIELD EQUATIONS were recorded as never computed by this stream; that was true of the stream and false of the repository, and the layer is now partly discharged (see current_gate). (3) THE GAUGE STRUCTURE (RP-DIFF, the BRST/BV complex) is UNTOUCHED and is the largest genuine hole: RP-DIFF is what makes 'the space of curvature scalars' the right space at all, so it never appears as a row in any matrix and has no independence witness. (4) THE SPECTRUM is partial: weyl-ghost-forced.md proves the uniqueness theorem and the ghost theorem are the same theorem, both following from D - 2k = 0; the DYNAMICAL consequence of the ghost is not characterized, and GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION showed the coprime obstruction does not decide it in either direction. Underneath all four sits the GEOMETRY column, which PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md itself calls 'the bulk of the intellectual content', imported and unverified.

body.current_gate: THE D = 6 CONFORMAL INVARIANT COUNT IS COMPUTED, IN FORGE, IN TWO STAGES, AND IT REACHES THE CITED 3. Stage one, REVERSE_PHYSICS_CUBIC_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 (rail curvature_invariants_d6_gate 26/26): the invariants CUBIC IN RIEMANN WITH NO DERIVATIVES number 1, 1, 2 across D = 4, 5, 6, with cubic curvature spans 6, 7, 8. Stage two, REVERSE_PHYSICS_DERIVATIVE_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 (rail curvature_invariants_deriv_gate 33/33): adding the weight-6 shapes that carry derivatives -- grad R grad R and R grad grad R -- the counts become 2, 2, 3. So D = 6 now MATCHES the cited count by computation rather than referencing it, and the derivative sector supplies EXACTLY ONE more invariant in every dimension examined -- which was not predicted, nor were the D = 4 and D = 5 values. TWO CAVEATS THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH THE 3. It is a LOWER BOUND: the weight-6 shape linear in the curvature with four derivatives (box box R) is not among the candidates, needing the metric at degree 6 where jets carry 924 terms per component, and that is where a fourth invariant would hide. Adding candidates can only raise the count -- a non-invariant candidate raises both ranks and leaves the difference alone -- so the direction is sound. And NO BASIS IS EXHIBITED: the count is a dimension, the two cubic Weyl contractions are shown invariant, the third invariant is not written down. WHY MATCHING A CITED NUMBER IS EVIDENCE HERE and not merely agreement: the D = 4 and D = 5 counts were not predicted; the uniform +1 was not; and the cubic sub-counts (spans 6, 7, 8 and invariants 1, 1, 2) are recomputed by the derivative gate through a DIFFERENT candidate pipeline and reproduce the separate certificate exactly. SUBSTRATE LANDED IN TANGO across five pushed commits. metric_inverse, the general non-diagonal inverse over the jet ring; metric_inverse_diag tightened; riemann_full; riemann_const; math/curvinv, the exact tensor layer. Then, for the derivative sector: JET MULTIPLY AND ADD NOW SCALE -- jet_accum found terms by LINEAR SCAN, making both quadratic in the result size, invisible at degree 2 and fatal at degree 4 where one Christoffel took 27 seconds; both now hash the exponent row into an i64 key, with the old implementations kept as jet_mul_ref/jet_add_ref serving as the ORACLE for jet_mul_gate 14/14, which compares them by a dense sweep of every monomial. Plus jet_truncate, and math/curvcov, the covariant derivatives carried as Taylor coefficient arrays rather than jets (as jets, D = 6 would be over a billion coefficient operations). curvature_covderiv_gate 23/23 certifies that layer against the second Bianchi identity, the Ricci commutator, the DIFFERENTIATED Bianchi identity and a symmetric space, in D = 4, 5 and 6. NEXT, in priority order. (1) THE PARITY HALF, still completely untouched: no epsilon-carrying candidate has been evaluated in any dimension, so the D = 6 analogue of the D = 4 parity result is open exactly as WEYL_ACTION_D6 records it. This is now the last unanswered half of that gate. (2) EXACTNESS: adding box box R would turn the D = 6 lower bound into a count, and needs degree-6 jets -- which the jet speedup may now make affordable, though it was not attempted. (3) EXHIBITING A BASIS, so the third invariant is written down rather than counted. (4) C-GHOST-DYNAMICS remains the last OPEN row of the comparison ledger. DISCIPLINE NOTE, AND IT KEEPS PAYING: mutation testing found three defects in this session's own work that a passing exit code hid. The Hessian extraction dropped its factor of 2 on the diagonal through an if/else precedence bug. A gate's own expect was miscounted at 16 against 17 checks, so it returned 16 and was read as green while that bug was failing -- gates now PRINT which check failed. And a metric fixture sat in normal coordinates, where Gamma(0) = 0 and every connection term is multiplied by zero; three mutations deleting or sign-flipping those terms scored a clean baseline against it. That is the same class of trap as the earlier g(base) = delta one, found both times only by mutation testing, never by reading the code.
body.stop_condition: EITHER every entry of the GEOMETRY column is discharged or explicitly cited to an existing certificate, the field-equation layer is characterized by variation rather than definition, and the gauge layer has at least one independence witness for RP-DIFF — at which point 'fully characterized' is a defensible claim for three of four layers with the fourth ledgered; OR a layer returns an exact obstruction showing the reverse-physics question is not well posed there, which is itself the deliverable and must be recorded with the same rails.
body.forbid: claiming any geometric fact is PROVED when it is DISCHARGED — the discharge verifies exactly at specific metrics, which is strictly stronger than an unverified import and strictly weaker than a theorem for all metrics, and the certificate must keep saying so in those words; asserting G8's W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2 without its signature qualification, since the Lorentzian Hodge star squares to -1 on two-forms (local_bv/hodge.py records eigenvalues pm i) so W_pm are complex conjugates there and the decomposition as stated is EUCLIDEAN; reinventing any convention this repository already maintains — three attempts in this stream (Riemann tensor, Bach tensor, action variation) each concluded 'we do not have this' about the STREAM while the REPOSITORY had it, and the fourth (the Hodge dual) produced a wrong normalization; promoting a discharge on a Ricci-flat metric to a statement about the R^2 or Ric^2 coefficients, which VANISH there and cannot be seen; using any certificate in this stream as evidence inside the Weyl classical or quantum chains — the one-way direction is load-bearing and is scanned by REVERSE_PHYSICS_CHAIN_IMPORTS_V1. THE CONVERSE IS NO LONGER FORBIDDEN: citing INTO this stream from the Weyl chains is permitted under four conditions (C1 no cycles, C2 tags travel, C3 pinned and fail-closed, C4 middle column only), because circularity requires a cycle and the dependency has always been one-way, while tag laundering is prevented by carrying the boundary rather than by refusing to cite. Stating a claim here at a dependency tag its imports do not support IS forbidden, and is checked mechanically; treating the coprime/ghost toy-model results as statements about Weyl gravity, which they explicitly are not.
